name: com.brainworks.bw_audio
description:
Unity control client for the bw_audio spatial-audio engine: a thin P/Invoke binding over the engine's C ABI (no audio crosses the boundary, only control). Drives a speaker array over ASIO/Dante (the CAVE starts with 24 speakers) plus binaural headphone output. Provides a centralized per-frame push (BwAudio.Engine) and a positional emitter (BwAudio.Emitter).

Ships the native engine for Windows x64, Linux x64, macOS (universal) and Android arm64; the speaker array needs ASIO on Windows. See the README for the required project setup (disable Unity's built-in audio).

samples.description: A click orbits the listener's head for six seconds. Synthesizes its own stimulus, so it needs no audio asset. The same demo every other binding ships.
